name: astril - Run from preprocessed images
desc: The normal entry point for real patient data. Segments a face-free preprocessed library (GBM_seg_v2 labels: 1=necrosis/non-enhancing tumor, 2=edema, 3=enhancing tumor, 4=resection cavity; or a custom model) and quantifies volumes. Upload the 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ folder written by local preprocessing. Inputs holding un-skull-stripped images are refused. Versions: astril-nf 0.1.0, astril 0.7.30.
fileRequirementsMessage: Upload ONLY the face-free 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ folder written by local preprocessing ({patient}/{exam}/*_brain-norm.nii.gz, *_brain.nii.gz, *_brainmask.nii.gz). Never upload raw DICOM/NIfTI, the full preprocessed_library/ (it contains _raw_passthrough/ whole-head copies), or anything not skull-stripped.
